── INES'S WEEK ──
Ines ran about 40 km a week before a stress reaction in the left shin and ten weeks off, and a physio has cleared Ines for walk-run three days a week, stopping if the shin aches. The goal is to run 30 minutes without walking by mid-October.
Recent weeks: none recorded.
This week: 5.1 km over 3 runs.
Body: "Shin quiet."
Feeling: "Nervous but happy to be back."

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Ines: Great first week back with the shin quiet and effort easy, so we take one small step: a little longer running inside each walk-run, same…
You did exactly what week one asked for: three even sessions, pain 0/10 each time, and the shin quiet the next morning. That earns a small progression, not a big one.
Safety flag: Stop-rule for the shin
Next week:
Mon: easy, walk-run 16 min, 4 rounds of 3 min easy running and 1 min walking, flat…
Tue: other, physio calf and hip routine, 20 min at home. Keeps the lower leg loading…
Wed: easy, walk-run 16 min, 4 rounds of 3 min easy running and 1 min walking, same route…
Thu: rest. Full day off running to let the shin settle mid-week.
Fri: other, physio calf and hip routine, 20 min, plus an optional 20 min easy walk…
Sat: easy, walk-run 18 min, 4 rounds of 3 min easy running and 1 min walking then a…
Sun: rest. Quiet day before next week starts; note how the shin feels on waking.
